correctness.rationale: For H=A5 on six Sylow-5 subgroups, the action is explicitly checked to be two-transitive and its binary permutation module has invariant submodules exactly 0<C<W<V with W even-coordinate-sum dimension 5. The maximal-subgroup argument for split elementary abelian semidirect products gives Phi(G_t)=rad_H(V^t)=W^t. A Sylow 2-subgroup P=V4 of H yields Phi(V^t⋊P)=[V,P]^t; five conjugate P-orbit matchings partition all 15 edges of K6, so their commutator-space intersection is C. Odd prime Sylows are cyclic of prime order. Thus Psi(G_t)=C^t, with quotient of size 2^(4t). The exact verifier independently checks the six-point base and the general t result is proved by direct sums, not extrapolation. No optimality claim.

value.rationale: The recent local Frattini framework asks how deeply Sylow Frattini cores sit inside the ordinary Frattini subgroup. This finding quantifies an unbounded exponential gap even with fixed nonsolvable quotient A5 and an elementary abelian kernel, linking the discrepancy to an A5 Sylow-2 one-factorization of K6. It is a structural infinite-family boundary, rather than a routine one-off count or a definitional restatement.
